archive_features.description: List of archive feature flags. Prefix with '!' to disable (e.g., 'unix', '!fat', 'xattrs'). These map directly to --with= and --without= options in casync(1).

chunk_size.description: Chunk size in format [MIN:]AVG[:MAX]. Unit suffixes: K, M, G (e.g., '32K:64K:128K', '1M').

delete.description: If true, delete files on disk not present in archive after extraction.

exclude_file.description: If true (default), respect .caexclude files in the source tree.

exclude_nodump.description: If false (default), exclude files with chattr +d (nodump) flag. Set true to disable this exclusion.

exclude_submounts.description: If true (default), exclude submounts (e.g., /proc, /sys) during archiving.

hardlink.description: If true (default), create hardlinks from seeds during extraction.

path.description: Path to archive (for 'make') or extract to (for 'extract'). Defaults to current directory.

punch_holes.description: If true, create sparse files during extraction.

rate_limit_bps.description: Maximum bandwidth in bytes/s for remote communication (e.g., NFS mounts). 0 = unlimited.

reflink.description: If true, create reflinks from seeds during extraction.

seed.description: Optional seed file or directory to improve deduplication and compression. Must be an absolute or relative path.

seed_output.description: If true, use existing output directory as seed during extraction.

store.description: Path to the chunk store directory. If not absolute, treated relative to index file's directory. Defaults to '.' (i.e., store in default.castr).

uid_shift.description: UID/GID shift setting: 'yes' (auto), 'no', or numeric shift offset (e.g., '65536').

undo_immutable.description: If true (default), undo chattr +i (immutable) flag when removing files during extraction.
